description_en: Queries the configuration information of a domain name that has been added to WAF protection
description_zh: 查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain --instance-id waf-cn-7pp26f10000 --domain www.example.com --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名名称。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html查询所有已添加到WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
